featured_reviews.name: Kush Sonigara
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Starbucks Kurla recently. The ambience is good, and the staff is generally courteous. However, I was a bit disappointed with the drink quality and overall value for money.
I had ordered a Choco Chip beverage and specifically requested low ice, but the drink still turned out extremely chilled and filled with ice, with very little actual coffee or milk. It honestly felt more like ice water than a proper coffee beverage.
When customers are paying a premium price for a cup of coffee, I believe their preferences and instructions should be taken more seriously. Starbucks should focus more on delivering better value and ensuring customer requests are properly followed. Overall, an okay experience, but definitely scope for improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Kaleen Bhaiya
featured_reviews.review_text: Stopped by today and had a really nice visit. The store was clean, service was fast, and my drink tasted great. Me and my friends really had a good time. Felt like family here ..... Big shoutout to the store manager Rahul and Aarya. Will definitely be back!

featured_reviews.name: Kartikeya Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Decent but Unremarkable Experience: Starbucks Phoenix Mall Review

I recently visited the Starbucks outlet in Phoenix Mall, Kurla, and had a decent but unremarkable experience. As a coffee lover, I was looking forward to trying their signature brews, but the overall experience was marred by average service and a crowded ambiance.

The Classic Cold Coffee was the highlight of our visit, with a rich and smooth flavor that hit the spot on a warm Sunday afternoon. However, the drink was not particularly unique or memorable, and we've had similar cold brews at other cafes.

The ambiance was decent, with the familiar Starbucks decor and comfortable seating. However, the cafe was completely full due to the Sunday crowd, which made it feel a bit chaotic and overwhelming.

Unfortunately, the staff was very average, which was a letdown given Starbucks' reputation for excellent customer service. Our server seemed overwhelmed and distracted, and it took a while to get our orders taken and fulfilled. We expected more from a global brand like Starbucks, especially in terms of service.

Overall, our experience at Starbucks Phoenix Mall was decent but unremarkable. While the coffee was good, the average service and crowded ambiance prevented us from having a truly enjoyable experience.

Price*: Moderate (around ₹400-₹600 per person)

Recommended for*: Coffee lovers who are looking for a reliable brew, but may not be the best choice for those seeking exceptional service or a unique experience.

Will I return?
Maybe, but I'll have to weigh my options and consider other cafes in the area that may offer a more memorable experience.

name: Barista
description: Our journey from the bean to the cup started in the year 2000. Cafe culture had not set its footprint and coffee was still considered a luxury. Our quest to provide a truly International experience and brew a truly Italian cuppa led us to create the brand Barista. Spearheading the Indian cafe culture, Barista was an opportunity to discover both the coffee and the craft. No one has mastered coffee better than the Italians. Tipping our hats their way, Barista brings new meaning to Italian coffee and eats in the Indian sub-continent. Today, we continue to brew coffee the way the world does and in our journey, we have created coffee relationships with our customers across India, Sri Lanka & Maldives.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Barista recently and honestly had such a comforting experience. The café has a very cozy, calm vibe that instantly makes you want to sit back, relax, and enjoy your time. It’s a great place for long conversations, casual meet-ups, or just spending some quiet time with good coffee.

We ordered a mix of food and beverages — panned sandwich and chicken tikka sandwich, both well-grilled, flavourful, and filling. The French fries were crispy and perfectly seasoned. For drinks, we tried the hot chocolate, cold coffee, and cappuccino — each one was smooth, rich, and well-balanced in taste. The cappuccino especially stood out with its nice aroma and creamy texture.

To end the meal, we tried one of their dark, rich desserts, which was indulgent without being overly sweet — a perfect finish. Everything felt fresh and thoughtfully prepared.

What really adds to the experience is the overall ambience — soft lighting, comfortable seating, and a pleasant crowd that makes the place feel warm and welcoming. The staff was polite and attentive, which always makes a difference.

Overall, Barista is a reliable spot for good coffee, tasty food, and genuinely nice vibes. Definitely a place I’d love to visit again and recommend to anyone looking for a relaxed café experience. ☕️✨

featured_reviews.name: sabbosilly
featured_reviews.review_text: Barista in Chembur is a great spot to unwind with a good cup of coffee. Cozy ambience, friendly staff, and consistently good brews. Perfect for casual meet-ups or a quiet coffee break.

featured_reviews.name: Akshaya Gogi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Coffees were very good. Prices were reasonable.  Our order:
1. Irish Cappuccino
2. Iced Cafe Mocha
3. Vanilla Classic Milkshake
4. Cafe Macchiato (Cortado Coffee)
5. French Fries
6. Cheese Chilly Toast
7. Veggie Delight Pizza
8. Mango Cheesecake Pastry

The food we ordered was also very good. I personally didn't like the mango cheesecake as much. I thought it should've had a bit of a lemon but the others enjoyed it.

The ambience is very good. The service is also amazing. You can sit here and work/study too. The cafe had wifi but I couldn't connect to it.

We went there in the evening so by the time we got out there were a few people smoking in the outside seating area. So if you cannot stand smoke, I'd suggest you to sit inside.

There's also a small flower shop(?) right next to the Café so you could buy some flowers while going back home. Do it for the plot.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Gurnani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wouldn't be sharing this experience here if the staff & management here ever considered a feedback to them rather making my poor experience public. I was visiting this Chembur outlet in my vicinity quite often for a few months and I learnt that most pple visit this place only because it has a good seating capacity, washroom & an outer seating space where one can smoke. With these perks comes alot of negative things like the irritating loud noise in the cafe making it difficult for you to share a conversation in person or over a call. Surprisingly its not the guests but the staff themselves who have been unnecessarily loud in the cafe over their personal issues.

Yet another thing I found most irritating is long gone from any other cafes is that some of the staff members is quite irritating when it comes to orders. Any guests in the cafe obviously knows that they are visiting for a beverage or food item and they need not be reminded every 10mins to place an order as one could be engrossed in some activity and planning to order a lil later. With me, I was on a work video call for about 25mins when 3 of their staff members came and said more than enough only bcoz I couldn't respond to them being on a work call. This kind of hospitality is not at all appreciated.

I hope now it reaches to right ears bcoz the Zomato reviews and ratings by other customers says it all.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Cheese Garlic Bread was a little disappointment, but Iced Cafe Mocha covered it up. If you like strong cold coffee, Iced Cafe Mocha is the one you should gun for.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Sankaran
featured_reviews.review_text: This tiny cafe on Waterfield Road is perfect for dinner with you and your family. The cozy setting, featuring pale green and pink decorations, gives you that perfect peaceful atmosphere. Earth Cafe offers a variety of options whether you’re vegetarian, Jain or just wanting something different. The food is high quality with something for everyone. The avocado bruschetta has the perfect amount of crispness and flavour. The fries are freshly made, perfect for a crunchy starter. The peach and mint mojito is to die for. To choose a main dish is nearly impossible. From freshly baked sourdough pizzas or piping hot risotto. The lasagna is an amazing dish with layered zucchini and a creamy vegan sauce. If you’re not already stuffed and want a sweet treat, they have a variety of cakes to choose from including some gluten free options. But the perfect treat for summer is the mango and cream. The service was exceptional and the staff were super helpful. Overall an amazing place to dine out. Rahul who served us during our visit was great.

featured_reviews.name: larissa jones
featured_reviews.review_text: Earth Café is a wonderful place with very high-quality food and plenty of healthy options to choose from. The service was attentive and extremely friendly, which made the experience even better. As their first customer of the day, we were kindly offered a free slice of cake — it was rich, delicious, and such a lovely surprise. The café itself has a beautiful design and a very welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended the masala tea, tofu scrambled egg and masala tea, and we’ll definitely be back!

featured_reviews.name: Taronish Khambata
featured_reviews.review_text:
Earth Cafe, at Waterfield Road, Bandra (W), is one of the most hospitable cafes I've ever had the pleasure of being at.

It has a cozy, warm atmosphere that instantly makes you feel at ease and comfort. I had the pleasure to be serviced by Ketan for food & beverages. He's kind, warm, hospitable, and ensures your needs are met.

Food here is clean, healthy, and delicious. I definitely recommend one pot rice & carrot walnut cake. They are delicious!

They also a free detox water counter for you to indulge in. Worth it!

Overall, I highly recommend you to visit this cafe, if you've never ever been to.

PS: They gave me this amazing chocolate pastry as a token of being an amazing guest. How sweet 🤍

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: S H
featured_reviews.review_text: Such a beautiful quaint place and so many vegan and veg options. Also gluten free friendly. I really enjoyed the Jack jack - which is a sweet potato dish and the carrot walnut cake which was a tad bit dry but still delicious. The coffee’s we ordered were also nice. We had Ketan help us today and he is super friendly and super attentive. He checked in on us and gave us special attention. We will definitely be coming here again.

featured_reviews.name: Manasvi Bhojwani
featured_reviews.review_text: The food is absolutely delicious!! Must visit if you you want to try a great variety of food! Nirmala was great at recommending options and I’m happy with her service. The food is so yum, delicious and healthy. They have gluten-free options as well which are easily available. Gluten free pizza is a dream! They have gluten free, keto, jain options and adjust the food to your allergies. Seriously, you need to come here if you want to try plant-based food!..

featured_reviews.name: Aarushie sethi

We were served by Nirmala at Earth Cafe and she honestly made our visit so much better. She was warm, attentive and very polite throughout — the kind of service that feels genuine, not forced. She kept checking in at the right time, helped us with recommendations and made sure we were comfortable without being intrusive.

It’s always the people who make a place memorable, and Nirmala is definitely one of them. Hope to be served by her again!

Worth wait for the food
